title: Microsoft Teams: desk utilisation analytics in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal
summary: Hold: the building-visibility command only reads settings, and the peripheral script only collects an import file rather than changing desk associations. The cloud-data path starts inside a tab, and the claimed August cutoff for the building-visibility default is not supported. The rollout window and published desk licence prices are supported.
